snippet.title: A.D.D. (Anomaly Detection Department) | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4914590/ADD_Anomaly_Detection_Department/

Welcome to A.D.D.

A.D.D. (Anomaly Detection Department) is a card-based strategy and management game where you send employees into unknown areas on behalf of the company and manage both the expedition process and its results.

Assign employees and connect nodes on the board to design expedition routes. Organize the records and byproducts recovered from each expedition, refine them into the required data, and submit the results requested by the company.

Manage limited board space as employees, records, data, and nodes continue to accumulate. Decide what to preserve, what to discard, and whose side you will take.

Explore.
Refine.
Submit.

Meet your quota.
Choose your side.

A.D.D. launches for free on Steam on July 31, 2026.

Developed by ONE MORE SPOON

Music by Tunetank from Pixabay:
